[566](https://docs.rs#566)        self.len = len;
[567](https://docs.rs#567)    }
[568](https://docs.rs#568)
[569](https://docs.rs#569)    #[inline]
[570](https://docs.rs#570)    unsafe fn set_tail_backward(&mut self) {
[571](https://docs.rs#571)        let new_tail = Self::wrap_sub(self.tail(), 1);
[572](https://docs.rs#572)        let new_len = self.len() + 1;
[573](https://docs.rs#573)        self.tail = new_tail;
[574](https://docs.rs#574)        self.len = new_len;
[575](https://docs.rs#575)    }
[576](https://docs.rs#576)
[577](https://docs.rs#577)    #[inline]
[578](https://docs.rs#578)    unsafe fn set_tail_forward(&mut self) {
[579](https://docs.rs#579)        debug_assert!(!self.is_empty());
[580](https://docs.rs#580)
[581](https://docs.rs#581)        let new_tail = Self::wrap_add(self.tail(), 1);
[582](https://docs.rs#582)        let new_len = self.len() - 1;
[583](https://docs.rs#583)        self.tail = new_tail;
[584](https://docs.rs#584)        self.len = new_len;
[585](https://docs.rs#585)    }
[586](https://docs.rs#586)
[587](https://docs.rs#587)    #[inline]
[588](https://docs.rs#588)    unsafe fn set_head_backward(&mut self) {
[589](https://docs.rs#589)        debug_assert!(!self.is_empty());
[590](https://docs.rs#590)
[591](https://docs.rs#591)        let new_len = self.len() - 1;
[592](https://docs.rs#592)        self.len = new_len;
[593](https://docs.rs#593)    }
[594](https://docs.rs#594)
[595](https://docs.rs#595)    #[inline]
[596](https://docs.rs#596)    unsafe fn set_head_forward(&mut self) {
[597](https://docs.rs#597)        debug_assert!(self.len() < CAP);
[598](https://docs.rs#598)
[599](https://docs.rs#599)        let new_len = self.len() + 1;
[600](https://docs.rs#600)        self.len = new_len;
[601](https://docs.rs#601)    }
[602](https://docs.rs#602)
[603](https://docs.rs#603)    #[inline]
[604](https://docs.rs#604)    unsafe fn push_front_unchecked(&mut self, element: T) {
[605](https://docs.rs#605)        debug_assert!(!self.is_full());
[606](https://docs.rs#606)
[607](https://docs.rs#607)        self.set_tail_backward();
[608](https://docs.rs#608)        let tail = self.tail();
[609](https://docs.rs#609)        self.buffer_write(tail, element);
[610](https://docs.rs#610)    }
[611](https://docs.rs#611)
[612](https://docs.rs#612)    #[inline]
[613](https://docs.rs#613)    unsafe fn push_back_unchecked(&mut self, element: T) {
[614](https://docs.rs#614)        debug_assert!(!self.is_full());
[615](https://docs.rs#615)
[616](https://docs.rs#616)        let head = self.head();
[617](https://docs.rs#617)        self.buffer_write(head, element);
[618](https://docs.rs#618)        self.set_head_forward();
[619](https://docs.rs#619)    }
[620](https://docs.rs#620)
[621](https://docs.rs#621)    #[allow(unused_unsafe)]
[622](https://docs.rs#622)    #[inline]
[623](https://docs.rs#623)    unsafe fn insert_unchecked(&mut self, index: usize, element: T) {
[624](https://docs.rs#624)        debug_assert!(!self.is_full());
[625](https://docs.rs#625)
[626](https://docs.rs#626)        // Move the least number of elements in the ring buffer and insert
[627](https://docs.rs#627)        // the given object
[628](https://docs.rs#628)        //
[629](https://docs.rs#629)        // At most len/2 - 1 elements will be moved. O(min(n, n-i))
[630](https://docs.rs#630)        //
[631](https://docs.rs#631)        // There are three main cases:
[632](https://docs.rs#632)        //  Elements are contiguous
[633](https://docs.rs#633)        //      - special case when tail is 0
[634](https://docs.rs#634)        //  Elements are discontiguous and the insert is in the tail section
[635](https://docs.rs#635)        //  Elements are discontiguous and the insert is in the head section
[636](https://docs.rs#636)        //
[637](https://docs.rs#637)        // For each of those there are two more cases:
[638](https://docs.rs#638)        //  Insert is closer to tail
[639](https://docs.rs#639)        //  Insert is closer to head
[640](https://docs.rs#640)        //
[641](https://docs.rs#641)        // Key: H - self.head
[642](https://docs.rs#642)        //      T - self.tail
[643](https://docs.rs#643)        //      o - Valid element
[644](https://docs.rs#644)        //      I - Insertion element
[645](https://docs.rs#645)        //      A - The element that should be after the insertion point
[646](https://docs.rs#646)        //      M - Indicates element was moved
[647](https://docs.rs#647)
[648](https://docs.rs#648)        let idx = Self::wrap_add(self.tail(), index);
[649](https://docs.rs#649)
[650](https://docs.rs#650)        let distance_to_tail = index;
[651](https://docs.rs#651)        let distance_to_head = self.len() - index;
[652](https://docs.rs#652)
[653](https://docs.rs#653)        let contiguous = self.is_contiguous();
[654](https://docs.rs#654)
[655](https://docs.rs#655)        match (
[656](https://docs.rs#656)            contiguous,
[657](https://docs.rs#657)            distance_to_tail <= distance_to_head,
[658](https://docs.rs#658)            idx >= self.tail(),
[659](https://docs.rs#659)        ) {
[660](https://docs.rs#660)            (true, true, _) if index == 0 => {
[661](https://docs.rs#661)                // push_front
[662](https://docs.rs#662)                //
[663](https://docs.rs#663)                //       T
[664](https://docs.rs#664)                //       I             H
[665](https://docs.rs#665)                //      [A o o o o o o . . . . . . . . .]
[666](https://docs.rs#666)                //
[667](https://docs.rs#667)                //                       H         T
[668](https://docs.rs#668)                //      [A o o o o o o o . . . . . I]
[669](https://docs.rs#669)                //
[670](https://docs.rs#670)
[671](https://docs.rs#671)                self.set_tail_backward();
[672](https://docs.rs#672)            }
[673](https://docs.rs#673)            (true, true, _) => {
[674](https://docs.rs#674)                unsafe {
[675](https://docs.rs#675)                    // contiguous, insert closer to tail:
[676](https://docs.rs#676)                    //
[677](https://docs.rs#677)                    //             T   I         H
[678](https://docs.rs#678)                    //      [. . . o o A o o o o . . . . . .]
[679](https://docs.rs#679)                    //
[680](https://docs.rs#680)                    //           T               H
[681](https://docs.rs#681)                    //      [. . o o I A o o o o . . . . . .]
[682](https://docs.rs#682)                    //           M M
[683](https://docs.rs#683)                    //
[684](https://docs.rs#684)                    // contiguous, insert closer to tail and tail is 0:
[685](https://docs.rs#685)                    //
[686](https://docs.rs#686)                    //
[687](https://docs.rs#687)                    //       T   I         H
[688](https://docs.rs#688)                    //      [o o A o o o o . . . . . . . . .]
[689](https://docs.rs#689)                    //
[690](https://docs.rs#690)                    //                       H             T
[691](https://docs.rs#691)                    //      [o I A o o o o o . . . . . . . o]
[692](https://docs.rs#692)                    //       M                             M
[693](https://docs.rs#693)
[694](https://docs.rs#694)                    let tail = self.tail();
[695](https://docs.rs#695)                    let new_tail = Self::wrap_sub(self.tail(), 1);
[696](https://docs.rs#696)
[697](https://docs.rs#697)                    self.copy(new_tail, tail, 1);
[698](https://docs.rs#698)                    // Already moved the tail, so we only copy `index - 1` elements.
[699](https://docs.rs#699)                    self.copy(tail, tail + 1, index - 1);
[700](https://docs.rs#700)
[701](https://docs.rs#701)                    self.set_tail_backward();
[702](https://docs.rs#702)                }
[703](https://docs.rs#703)            }
[704](https://docs.rs#704)            (true, false, _) => {
[705](https://docs.rs#705)                unsafe {
[706](https://docs.rs#706)                    //  contiguous, insert closer to head:
[707](https://docs.rs#707)                    //
[708](https://docs.rs#708)                    //             T       I     H
[709](https://docs.rs#709)                    //      [. . . o o o o A o o . . . . . .]
[710](https://docs.rs#710)                    //
[711](https://docs.rs#711)                    //             T               H
[712](https://docs.rs#712)                    //      [. . . o o o o I A o o . . . . .]
[713](https://docs.rs#713)                    //                       M M M
[714](https://docs.rs#714)
[715](https://docs.rs#715)                    let head = self.head();
[716](https://docs.rs#716)                    self.copy(idx + 1, idx, head - idx);
[717](https://docs.rs#717)
[718](https://docs.rs#718)                    self.set_head_forward();
[719](https://docs.rs#719)                }
[720](https://docs.rs#720)            }
[721](https://docs.rs#721)            (false, true, true) => {
[722](https://docs.rs#722)                unsafe {
[723](https://docs.rs#723)                    // discontiguous, insert closer to tail, tail section:
[724](https://docs.rs#724)                    //
[725](https://docs.rs#725)                    //                   H         T   I
[726](https://docs.rs#726)                    //      [o o o o o o . . . . . o o A o o]
[727](https://docs.rs#727)                    //
[728](https://docs.rs#728)                    //                   H       T
[729](https://docs.rs#729)                    //      [o o o o o o . . . . o o I A o o]
[730](https://docs.rs#730)                    //                           M M
[731](https://docs.rs#731)
[732](https://docs.rs#732)                    let tail = self.tail();
[733](https://docs.rs#733)                    self.copy(tail - 1, tail, index);
[734](https://docs.rs#734)
[735](https://docs.rs#735)                    self.set_tail_backward();
[736](https://docs.rs#736)                }
[737](https://docs.rs#737)            }
[738](https://docs.rs#738)            (false, false, true) => {
[739](https://docs.rs#739)                unsafe {
[740](https://docs.rs#740)                    // discontiguous, insert closer to head, tail section:
[741](https://docs.rs#741)                    //
[742](https://docs.rs#742)                    //           H             T         I
[743](https://docs.rs#743)                    //      [o o . . . . . . . o o o o o A o]
[744](https://docs.rs#744)                    //
[745](https://docs.rs#745)                    //             H           T
[746](https://docs.rs#746)                    //      [o o o . . . . . . o o o o o I A]
[747](https://docs.rs#747)                    //       M M M                         M
[748](https://docs.rs#748)
[749](https://docs.rs#749)                    // copy elements up to new head
[750](https://docs.rs#750)                    let head = self.head();
[751](https://docs.rs#751)                    self.copy(1, 0, head);
[752](https://docs.rs#752)
[753](https://docs.rs#753)                    // copy last element into empty spot at bottom of buffer
[754](https://docs.rs#754)                    self.copy(0, CAP - 1, 1);
[755](https://docs.rs#755)
[756](https://docs.rs#756)                    // move elements from idx to end forward not including ^ element
[757](https://docs.rs#757)                    self.copy(idx + 1, idx, CAP - 1 - idx);
[758](https://docs.rs#758)
[759](https://docs.rs#759)                    self.set_head_forward();
[760](https://docs.rs#760)                }
[761](https://docs.rs#761)            }
[762](https://docs.rs#762)            (false, true, false) if idx == 0 => {
[763](https://docs.rs#763)                unsafe {
[764](https://docs.rs#764)                    // discontiguous, insert is closer to tail, head section,
[765](https://docs.rs#765)                    // and is at index zero in the internal buffer:
[766](https://docs.rs#766)                    //
[767](https://docs.rs#767)                    //       I                   H     T
[768](https://docs.rs#768)                    //      [A o o o o o o o o o . . . o o o]
[769](https://docs.rs#769)                    //
[770](https://docs.rs#770)                    //                           H   T
[771](https://docs.rs#771)                    //      [A o o o o o o o o o . . o o o I]
[772](https://docs.rs#772)                    //                               M M M
[773](https://docs.rs#773)
[774](https://docs.rs#774)                    // copy elements up to new tail
[775](https://docs.rs#775)                    let tail = self.tail();
[776](https://docs.rs#776)                    self.copy(tail - 1, tail, CAP - tail);
[777](https://docs.rs#777)
[778](https://docs.rs#778)                    // copy last element into empty spot at bottom of buffer
[779](https://docs.rs#779)                    self.copy(CAP - 1, 0, 1);
[780](https://docs.rs#780)
[781](https://docs.rs#781)                    self.set_tail_backward();
[782](https://docs.rs#782)                }
[783](https://docs.rs#783)            }
[784](https://docs.rs#784)            (false, true, false) => {
[785](https://docs.rs#785)                unsafe {
[786](https://docs.rs#786)                    // discontiguous, insert closer to tail, head section:
[787](https://docs.rs#787)                    //
[788](https://docs.rs#788)                    //             I             H     T
[789](https://docs.rs#789)                    //      [o o o A o o o o o o . . . o o o]
[790](https://docs.rs#790)                    //
[791](https://docs.rs#791)                    //                           H   T
[792](https://docs.rs#792)                    //      [o o I A o o o o o o . . o o o o]
[793](https://docs.rs#793)                    //       M M                     M M M M
[794](https://docs.rs#794)
[795](https://docs.rs#795)                    let tail = self.tail();
[796](https://docs.rs#796)                    // copy elements up to new tail
[797](https://docs.rs#797)                    self.copy(tail - 1, tail, CAP - tail);
[798](https://docs.rs#798)
[799](https://docs.rs#799)                    // copy last element into empty spot at bottom of buffer
[800](https://docs.rs#800)                    self.copy(CAP - 1, 0, 1);
[801](https://docs.rs#801)
[802](https://docs.rs#802)                    // move elements from idx-1 to end forward not including ^ element
[803](https://docs.rs#803)                    self.copy(0, 1, idx - 1);
[804](https://docs.rs#804)
[805](https://docs.rs#805)                    self.set_tail_backward();
[806](https://docs.rs#806)                }
[807](https://docs.rs#807)            }
[808](https://docs.rs#808)            (false, false, false) => {
[809](https://docs.rs#809)                unsafe {
[810](https://docs.rs#810)                    // discontiguous, insert closer to head, head section:
[811](https://docs.rs#811)                    //
[812](https://docs.rs#812)                    //               I     H           T
[813](https://docs.rs#813)                    //      [o o o o A o o . . . . . . o o o]
[814](https://docs.rs#814)                    //
[815](https://docs.rs#815)                    //                     H           T
[816](https://docs.rs#816)                    //      [o o o o I A o o . . . . . o o o]
[817](https://docs.rs#817)                    //                 M M M
[818](https://docs.rs#818)
[819](https://docs.rs#819)                    let head = self.head();
[820](https://docs.rs#820)                    self.copy(idx + 1, idx, head - idx);
[821](https://docs.rs#821)
[822](https://docs.rs#822)                    self.set_head_forward();
[823](https://docs.rs#823)                }
[824](https://docs.rs#824)            }
[825](https://docs.rs#825)        }
[826](https://docs.rs#826)
[827](https://docs.rs#827)        // tail might've been changed so we need to recalculate
[828](https://docs.rs#828)        let new_idx = Self::wrap_add(self.tail(), index);
[829](https://docs.rs#829)        unsafe {
[830](https://docs.rs#830)            self.buffer_write(new_idx, element);
[831](https://docs.rs#831)        }
[832](https://docs.rs#832)    }
[833](https://docs.rs#833)
[834](https://docs.rs#834)    /// Copies a contiguous block of memory len long from src to dst
[835](https://docs.rs#835)    #[inline]
[836](https://docs.rs#836)    unsafe fn copy(&mut self, dst: usize, src: usize, len: usize) {
[837](https://docs.rs#837)        debug_assert!(
[838](https://docs.rs#838)            dst + len <= CAP,
[839](https://docs.rs#839)            "cpy dst={} src={} len={} cap={}",
[840](https://docs.rs#840)            dst,
[841](https://docs.rs#841)            src,
[842](https://docs.rs#842)            len,
[843](https://docs.rs#843)            CAP
[844](https://docs.rs#844)        );
[845](https://docs.rs#845)        debug_assert!(
[846](https://docs.rs#846)            src + len <= CAP,
[847](https://docs.rs#847)            "cpy dst={} src={} len={} cap={}",
[848](https://docs.rs#848)            dst,
[849](https://docs.rs#849)            src,
[850](https://docs.rs#850)            len,
[851](https://docs.rs#851)            CAP
[852](https://docs.rs#852)        );
[853](https://docs.rs#853)        let xs = self.ptr_mut();
[854](https://docs.rs#854)        ptr::copy(xs.add(src), xs.add(dst), len);
[855](https://docs.rs#855)    }
[856](https://docs.rs#856)
[857](https://docs.rs#857)    /// Copies a potentially wrapping block of memory len long from src to dest.
[858](https://docs.rs#858)    /// (abs(dst - src) + len) must be no larger than cap() (There must be at
[859](https://docs.rs#859)    /// most one continuous overlapping region between src and dest).
[860](https://docs.rs#860)    unsafe fn wrap_copy(&mut self, dst: usize, src: usize, len: usize) {
[861](https://docs.rs#861)        #[allow(dead_code)]
[862](https://docs.rs#862)        fn diff(a: usize, b: usize) -> usize {
[863](https://docs.rs#863)            if a <= b {
[864](https://docs.rs#864)                b - a
[865](https://docs.rs#865)            } else {
[866](https://docs.rs#866)                a - b
[867](https://docs.rs#867)            }
[868](https://docs.rs#868)        }
[869](https://docs.rs#869)        debug_assert!(
[870](https://docs.rs#870)            cmp::min(diff(dst, src), CAP - diff(dst, src)) + len <= CAP,
[871](https://docs.rs#871)            "wrc dst={} src={} len={} cap={}",
[872](https://docs.rs#872)            dst,
[873](https://docs.rs#873)            src,
[874](https://docs.rs#874)            len,
[875](https://docs.rs#875)            CAP
[876](https://docs.rs#876)        );
[877](https://docs.rs#877)
[878](https://docs.rs#878)        if src == dst || len == 0 {
[879](https://docs.rs#879)            return;
[880](https://docs.rs#880)        }
[881](https://docs.rs#881)
[882](https://docs.rs#882)        let dst_after_src = Self::wrap_sub(dst, src) < len;
[883](https://docs.rs#883)
[884](https://docs.rs#884)        let src_pre_wrap_len = CAP - src;
[885](https://docs.rs#885)        let dst_pre_wrap_len = CAP - dst;
[886](https://docs.rs#886)        let src_wraps = src_pre_wrap_len < len;
[887](https://docs.rs#887)        let dst_wraps = dst_pre_wrap_len < len;
[888](https://docs.rs#888)
[889](https://docs.rs#889)        match (dst_after_src, src_wraps, dst_wraps) {
[890](https://docs.rs#890)            (_, false, false) => {
[891](https://docs.rs#891)                // src doesn't wrap, dst doesn't wrap
[892](https://docs.rs#892)                //
[893](https://docs.rs#893)                //        S . . .
[894](https://docs.rs#894)                // 1 [_ _ A A B B C C _]
[895](https://docs.rs#895)                // 2 [_ _ A A A A B B _]
[896](https://docs.rs#896)                //            D . . .
[897](https://docs.rs#897)                //
[898](https://docs.rs#898)                self.copy(dst, src, len);
[899](https://docs.rs#899)            }
[900](https://docs.rs#900)            (false, false, true) => {
[901](https://docs.rs#901)                // dst before src, src doesn't wrap, dst wraps
[902](https://docs.rs#902)                //
[903](https://docs.rs#903)                //    S . . .
[904](https://docs.rs#904)                // 1 [A A B B _ _ _ C C]
[905](https://docs.rs#905)                // 2 [A A B B _ _ _ A A]
[906](https://docs.rs#906)                // 3 [B B B B _ _ _ A A]
[907](https://docs.rs#907)                //    . .           D .
[908](https://docs.rs#908)                //
[909](https://docs.rs#909)                self.copy(dst, src, dst_pre_wrap_len);
[910](https://docs.rs#910)                self.copy(0, src + dst_pre_wrap_len, len - dst_pre_wrap_len);
[911](https://docs.rs#911)            }
[912](https://docs.rs#912)            (true, false, true) => {
[913](https://docs.rs#913)                // src before dst, src doesn't wrap, dst wraps
[914](https://docs.rs#914)                //
[915](https://docs.rs#915)                //              S . . .
[916](https://docs.rs#916)                // 1 [C C _ _ _ A A B B]
[917](https://docs.rs#917)                // 2 [B B _ _ _ A A B B]
[918](https://docs.rs#918)                // 3 [B B _ _ _ A A A A]
[919](https://docs.rs#919)                //    . .           D .
[920](https://docs.rs#920)                //
[921](https://docs.rs#921)                self.copy(0, src + dst_pre_wrap_len, len - dst_pre_wrap_len);
[922](https://docs.rs#922)                self.copy(dst, src, dst_pre_wrap_len);
[923](https://docs.rs#923)            }
[924](https://docs.rs#924)            (false, true, false) => {
[925](https://docs.rs#925)                // dst before src, src wraps, dst doesn't wrap
[926](https://docs.rs#926)                //
[927](https://docs.rs#927)                //    . .           S .
[928](https://docs.rs#928)                // 1 [C C _ _ _ A A B B]
[929](https://docs.rs#929)                // 2 [C C _ _ _ B B B B]
[930](https://docs.rs#930)                // 3 [C C _ _ _ B B C C]
[931](https://docs.rs#931)                //              D . . .
[932](https://docs.rs#932)                //
[933](https://docs.rs#933)                self.copy(dst, src, src_pre_wrap_len);
[934](https://docs.rs#934)                self.copy(dst + src_pre_wrap_len, 0, len - src_pre_wrap_len);
[935](https://docs.rs#935)            }
[936](https://docs.rs#936)            (true, true, false) => {
[937](https://docs.rs#937)                // src before dst, src wraps, dst doesn't wrap
[938](https://docs.rs#938)                //
[939](https://docs.rs#939)                //    . .           S .
[940](https://docs.rs#940)                // 1 [A A B B _ _ _ C C]
[941](https://docs.rs#941)                // 2 [A A A A _ _ _ C C]
[942](https://docs.rs#942)                // 3 [C C A A _ _ _ C C]
[943](https://docs.rs#943)                //    D . . .
[944](https://docs.rs#944)                //
[945](https://docs.rs#945)                self.copy(dst + src_pre_wrap_len, 0, len - src_pre_wrap_len);
[946](https://docs.rs#946)                self.copy(dst, src, src_pre_wrap_len);
[947](https://docs.rs#947)            }
[948](https://docs.rs#948)            (false, true, true) => {
[949](https://docs.rs#949)                // dst before src, src wraps, dst wraps
[950](https://docs.rs#950)                //
[951](https://docs.rs#951)                //    . . .         S .
[952](https://docs.rs#952)                // 1 [A B C D _ E F G H]
[953](https://docs.rs#953)                // 2 [A B C D _ E G H H]
[954](https://docs.rs#954)                // 3 [A B C D _ E G H A]
[955](https://docs.rs#955)                // 4 [B C C D _ E G H A]
[956](https://docs.rs#956)                //    . .         D . .
[957](https://docs.rs#957)                //
[958](https://docs.rs#958)                debug_assert!(dst_pre_wrap_len > src_pre_wrap_len);
[959](https://docs.rs#959)                let delta = dst_pre_wrap_len - src_pre_wrap_len;
[960](https://docs.rs#960)                self.copy(dst, src, src_pre_wrap_len);
[961](https://docs.rs#961)                self.copy(dst + src_pre_wrap_len, 0, delta);
[962](https://docs.rs#962)                self.copy(0, delta, len - dst_pre_wrap_len);
[963](https://docs.rs#963)            }
[964](https://docs.rs#964)            (true, true, true) => {
[965](https://docs.rs#965)                // src before dst, src wraps, dst wraps
[966](https://docs.rs#966)                //
[967](https://docs.rs#967)                //    . .         S . .
[968](https://docs.rs#968)                // 1 [A B C D _ E F G H]
[969](https://docs.rs#969)                // 2 [A A B D _ E F G H]
[970](https://docs.rs#970)                // 3 [H A B D _ E F G H]
[971](https://docs.rs#971)                // 4 [H A B D _ E F F G]
[972](https://docs.rs#972)                //    . . .         D .
[973](https://docs.rs#973)                //
[974](https://docs.rs#974)                debug_assert!(src_pre_wrap_len > dst_pre_wrap_len);
[975](https://docs.rs#975)                let delta = src_pre_wrap_len - dst_pre_wrap_len;
[976](https://docs.rs#976)                self.copy(delta, 0, len - src_pre_wrap_len);
[977](https://docs.rs#977)                self.copy(0, CAP - delta, delta);
[978](https://docs.rs#978)                self.copy(dst, src, dst_pre_wrap_len);
[979](https://docs.rs#979)            }
[980](https://docs.rs#980)        }
[981](https://docs.rs#981)    }
[982](https://docs.rs#982)
[983](https://docs.rs#983)    #[inline]

[1124](https://docs.rs#1124)    /// Provides a reference to the front element, or `None` if the sequence is

[1325](https://docs.rs#1325)    /// Make the buffer contiguous
[1326](https://docs.rs#1326)    ///
[1327](https://docs.rs#1327)    /// The linearization may be required when interacting with external
[1328](https://docs.rs#1328)    /// interfaces requiring contiguous slices.
[1329](https://docs.rs#1329)    ///
[1330](https://docs.rs#1330)    /// # Examples
[1331](https://docs.rs#1331)    ///
[1332](https://docs.rs#1332)    /// ```
[1333](https://docs.rs#1333)    /// use arraydeque::ArrayDeque;
[1334](https://docs.rs#1334)    ///
[1335](https://docs.rs#1335)    /// let mut buf: ArrayDeque<isize, 10> = ArrayDeque::new();
[1336](https://docs.rs#1336)    /// buf.extend_back([1, 2, 3]);
[1337](https://docs.rs#1337)    /// buf.extend_front([-1, -2, -3]);
[1338](https://docs.rs#1338)    ///
[1339](https://docs.rs#1339)    /// buf.linearize();
[1340](https://docs.rs#1340)    ///
[1341](https://docs.rs#1341)    /// assert_eq!(buf.as_slices().1.len(), 0);
[1342](https://docs.rs#1342)    /// ```
[1343](https://docs.rs#1343)    ///
[1344](https://docs.rs#1344)    /// # Complexity
[1345](https://docs.rs#1345)    ///
[1346](https://docs.rs#1346)    /// Takes `O(len())` time and no extra space.
[1347](https://docs.rs#1347)    pub fn linearize(&mut self) {
[1348](https://docs.rs#1348)        if self.is_contiguous() {
[1349](https://docs.rs#1349)            return;
[1350](https://docs.rs#1350)        }
[1351](https://docs.rs#1351)
[1352](https://docs.rs#1352)        let tail = self.tail();
[1353](https://docs.rs#1353)        let len = self.len();
[1354](https://docs.rs#1354)        let mut new_tail = tail;
[1355](https://docs.rs#1355)        let mut dst: usize = 0;
[1356](https://docs.rs#1356)
[1357](https://docs.rs#1357)        while dst < len {
[1358](https://docs.rs#1358)            let mut src = new_tail;
[1359](https://docs.rs#1359)
[1360](https://docs.rs#1360)            while src < CAP && dst < len {
[1361](https://docs.rs#1361)                if dst == new_tail {
[1362](https://docs.rs#1362)                    new_tail = src;
[1363](https://docs.rs#1363)                }
[1364](https://docs.rs#1364)
[1365](https://docs.rs#1365)                let xs = self.ptr_mut();
[1366](https://docs.rs#1366)                unsafe {
[1367](https://docs.rs#1367)                    ptr::swap(xs.add(dst), xs.add(src));
[1368](https://docs.rs#1368)                }
[1369](https://docs.rs#1369)
[1370](https://docs.rs#1370)                dst += 1;
[1371](https://docs.rs#1371)                src += 1;
[1372](https://docs.rs#1372)            }
[1373](https://docs.rs#1373)        }
[1374](https://docs.rs#1374)
[1375](https://docs.rs#1375)        unsafe {
[1376](https://docs.rs#1376)            self.set_tail(0);
[1377](https://docs.rs#1377)        }
[1378](https://docs.rs#1378)    }
[1379](https://docs.rs#1379)
[1380](https://docs.rs#1380)    /// Removes the first element and returns it, or `None` if the sequence is
[1381](https://docs.rs#1381)    /// empty.
[1382](https://docs.rs#1382)    ///
[1383](https://docs.rs#1383)    /// # Examples
[1384](https://docs.rs#1384)    ///
[1385](https://docs.rs#1385)    /// ```
[1386](https://docs.rs#1386)    /// use arraydeque::ArrayDeque;
[1387](https://docs.rs#1387)    ///
[1388](https://docs.rs#1388)    /// let mut buf: ArrayDeque<_, 2> = ArrayDeque::new();
[1389](https://docs.rs#1389)    ///
[1390](https://docs.rs#1390)    /// buf.push_back(1);
[1391](https://docs.rs#1391)    /// buf.push_back(2);
[1392](https://docs.rs#1392)    ///
[1393](https://docs.rs#1393)    /// assert_eq!(buf.pop_front(), Some(1));
[1394](https://docs.rs#1394)    /// assert_eq!(buf.pop_front(), Some(2));
[1395](https://docs.rs#1395)    /// assert_eq!(buf.pop_front(), None);
[1396](https://docs.rs#1396)    /// ```
[1397](https://docs.rs#1397)    pub fn pop_front(&mut self) -> Option<T> {
[1398](https://docs.rs#1398)        if self.is_empty() {
[1399](https://docs.rs#1399)            return None;
[1400](https://docs.rs#1400)        }
[1401](https://docs.rs#1401)        unsafe {
[1402](https://docs.rs#1402)            let tail = self.tail();
[1403](https://docs.rs#1403)            self.set_tail_forward();
[1404](https://docs.rs#1404)            Some(self.buffer_read(tail))
[1405](https://docs.rs#1405)        }
[1406](https://docs.rs#1406)    }
[1407](https://docs.rs#1407)
[1408](https://docs.rs#1408)    /// Removes the last element from a buffer and returns it, or `None` if
[1409](https://docs.rs#1409)    /// it is empty.
[1410](https://docs.rs#1410)    ///
[1411](https://docs.rs#1411)    /// # Examples

[1413](https://docs.rs#1413)    /// ```
[1414](https://docs.rs#1414)    /// use arraydeque::ArrayDeque;

[1416](https://docs.rs#1416)    /// let mut buf: ArrayDeque<_, 2> = ArrayDeque::new();

[1418](https://docs.rs#1418)    ///
[1419](https://docs.rs#1419)    /// buf.push_back(1);
[1420](https://docs.rs#1420)    /// buf.push_back(2);
[1421](https://docs.rs#1421)    ///
[1422](https://docs.rs#1422)    /// assert_eq!(buf.pop_back(), Some(2));
[1423](https://docs.rs#1423)    /// assert_eq!(buf.pop_back(), Some(1));
[1424](https://docs.rs#1424)    /// ```
[1425](https://docs.rs#1425)    pub fn pop_back(&mut self) -> Option<T> {
[1426](https://docs.rs#1426)        if self.is_empty() {
[1427](https://docs.rs#1427)            return None;
[1428](https://docs.rs#1428)        }
[1429](https://docs.rs#1429)        unsafe {
[1430](https://docs.rs#1430)            self.set_head_backward();
[1431](https://docs.rs#1431)            let head = self.head();
[1432](https://docs.rs#1432)            Some(self.buffer_read(head))
[1433](https://docs.rs#1433)        }
[1434](https://docs.rs#1434)    }

[1436](https://docs.rs#1436)    /// Clears the buffer, removing all values.

[1454](https://docs.rs#1454)
[1455](https://docs.rs#1455)    /// Create a draining iterator that removes the specified range in the
[1456](https://docs.rs#1456)    /// `ArrayDeque` and yields the removed items.
[1457](https://docs.rs#1457)    ///
[1458](https://docs.rs#1458)    /// Note 1: The element range is removed even if the iterator is not
[1459](https://docs.rs#1459)    /// consumed until the end.
[1460](https://docs.rs#1460)    ///
[1461](https://docs.rs#1461)    /// Note 2: It is unspecified how many elements are removed from the deque,
[1462](https://docs.rs#1462)    /// if the `Drain` value is not dropped, but the borrow it holds expires
[1463](https://docs.rs#1463)    /// (eg. due to mem::forget).
[1464](https://docs.rs#1464)    ///
[1465](https://docs.rs#1465)    /// # Panics
[1466](https://docs.rs#1466)    ///
[1467](https://docs.rs#1467)    /// Panics if the starting point is greater than the end point or if
[1468](https://docs.rs#1468)    /// the end point is greater than the length of the deque.
[1469](https://docs.rs#1469)    ///
[1470](https://docs.rs#1470)    /// # Examples
[1471](https://docs.rs#1471)    ///
[1472](https://docs.rs#1472)    /// ```
[1473](https://docs.rs#1473)    /// use arraydeque::ArrayDeque;
[1474](https://docs.rs#1474)    ///
[1475](https://docs.rs#1475)    /// let mut buf: ArrayDeque<_, 3> = ArrayDeque::new();
[1476](https://docs.rs#1476)    ///
[1477](https://docs.rs#1477)    /// buf.push_back(0);
[1478](https://docs.rs#1478)    /// buf.push_back(1);
[1479](https://docs.rs#1479)    /// buf.push_back(2);
[1480](https://docs.rs#1480)    ///
[1481](https://docs.rs#1481)    /// {
[1482](https://docs.rs#1482)    ///     let drain = buf.drain(2..);
[1483](https://docs.rs#1483)    ///     assert!([2].into_iter().eq(drain));
[1484](https://docs.rs#1484)    /// }
[1485](https://docs.rs#1485)    ///
[1486](https://docs.rs#1486)    /// {
[1487](https://docs.rs#1487)    ///     let iter = buf.iter();
[1488](https://docs.rs#1488)    ///     assert!([0, 1].iter().eq(iter));
[1489](https://docs.rs#1489)    /// }
[1490](https://docs.rs#1490)    ///
[1491](https://docs.rs#1491)    /// // A full range clears all contents
[1492](https://docs.rs#1492)    /// buf.drain(..);
[1493](https://docs.rs#1493)    /// assert!(buf.is_empty());
[1494](https://docs.rs#1494)    /// ```
[1495](https://docs.rs#1495)    #[track_caller]
[1496](https://docs.rs#1496)    #[inline]
[1497](https://docs.rs#1497)    pub fn drain<R>(&mut self, range: R) -> Drain<T, CAP, B>
[1498](https://docs.rs#1498)    where
[1499](https://docs.rs#1499)        R: RangeArgument<usize>,
[1500](https://docs.rs#1500)    {
[1501](https://docs.rs#1501)        let len = self.len();
[1502](https://docs.rs#1502)        let start = range.start().unwrap_or(0);
[1503](https://docs.rs#1503)        let end = range.end().unwrap_or(len);
[1504](https://docs.rs#1504)        assert!(start <= end, "drain lower bound was too large");
[1505](https://docs.rs#1505)        assert!(end <= len, "drain upper bound was too large");
[1506](https://docs.rs#1506)
[1507](https://docs.rs#1507)        let drain_tail = Self::wrap_add(self.tail(), start);
[1508](https://docs.rs#1508)        let drain_head = Self::wrap_add(self.tail(), end);
[1509](https://docs.rs#1509)        let drain_len = end - start;
[1510](https://docs.rs#1510)
[1511](https://docs.rs#1511)        unsafe { self.set_len(start) }
[1512](https://docs.rs#1512)
[1513](https://docs.rs#1513)        Drain {
[1514](https://docs.rs#1514)            deque: self as *mut _,
[1515](https://docs.rs#1515)            after_tail: drain_head,
[1516](https://docs.rs#1516)            after_len: len - end,
[1517](https://docs.rs#1517)            iter: Iter {
[1518](https://docs.rs#1518)                tail: drain_tail,
[1519](https://docs.rs#1519)                len: drain_len,
[1520](https://docs.rs#1520)                ring: self.as_uninit_slice_mut(),
[1521](https://docs.rs#1521)            },
[1522](https://docs.rs#1522)        }
[1523](https://docs.rs#1523)    }
[1524](https://docs.rs#1524)
[1525](https://docs.rs#1525)    /// Swaps elements at indices `i` and `j`.
[1526](https://docs.rs#1526)    ///
[1527](https://docs.rs#1527)    /// `i` and `j` may be equal.
[1528](https://docs.rs#1528)    ///
[1529](https://docs.rs#1529)    /// Fails if there is no element with either index.
[1530](https://docs.rs#1530)    ///
[1531](https://docs.rs#1531)    /// Element at index 0 is the front of the queue.
[1532](https://docs.rs#1532)    ///
[1533](https://docs.rs#1533)    /// # Examples
[1534](https://docs.rs#1534)    ///
[1535](https://docs.rs#1535)    /// ```
[1536](https://docs.rs#1536)    /// use arraydeque::ArrayDeque;
[1537](https://docs.rs#1537)    ///
[1538](https://docs.rs#1538)    /// let mut buf: ArrayDeque<_, 3> = ArrayDeque::new();
[1539](https://docs.rs#1539)    ///
[1540](https://docs.rs#1540)    /// buf.push_back(0);
[1541](https://docs.rs#1541)    /// buf.push_back(1);
[1542](https://docs.rs#1542)    /// buf.push_back(2);
[1543](https://docs.rs#1543)    ///
[1544](https://docs.rs#1544)    /// buf.swap(0, 2);
[1545](https://docs.rs#1545)    ///
[1546](https://docs.rs#1546)    /// assert_eq!(buf, [2, 1, 0].into());
[1547](https://docs.rs#1547)    /// ```
[1548](https://docs.rs#1548)    #[track_caller]
[1549](https://docs.rs#1549)    #[inline]
[1550](https://docs.rs#1550)    pub fn swap(&mut self, i: usize, j: usize) {
[1551](https://docs.rs#1551)        assert!(i < self.len());
[1552](https://docs.rs#1552)        assert!(j < self.len());
[1553](https://docs.rs#1553)        let ri = Self::wrap_add(self.tail(), i);
[1554](https://docs.rs#1554)        let rj = Self::wrap_add(self.tail(), j);
[1555](https://docs.rs#1555)        let xs = self.ptr_mut();
[1556](https://docs.rs#1556)        unsafe { ptr::swap(xs.add(ri), xs.add(rj)) }
[1557](https://docs.rs#1557)    }
[1558](https://docs.rs#1558)
[1559](https://docs.rs#1559)    /// Removes an element from anywhere in the `ArrayDeque` and returns it, replacing it with the
[1560](https://docs.rs#1560)    /// last element.
[1561](https://docs.rs#1561)    ///
[1562](https://docs.rs#1562)    /// This does not preserve ordering, but is O(1).
[1563](https://docs.rs#1563)    ///
[1564](https://docs.rs#1564)    /// Returns `None` if `index` is out of bounds.
[1565](https://docs.rs#1565)    ///
[1566](https://docs.rs#1566)    /// Element at index 0 is the front of the queue.
[1567](https://docs.rs#1567)    ///
[1568](https://docs.rs#1568)    /// # Examples
[1569](https://docs.rs#1569)    ///
[1570](https://docs.rs#1570)    /// ```
[1571](https://docs.rs#1571)    /// use arraydeque::ArrayDeque;
[1572](https://docs.rs#1572)    ///
[1573](https://docs.rs#1573)    /// let mut buf: ArrayDeque<_, 3> = ArrayDeque::new();
[1574](https://docs.rs#1574)    /// assert_eq!(buf.swap_remove_back(0), None);
[1575](https://docs.rs#1575)    ///
[1576](https://docs.rs#1576)    /// buf.push_back(0);
[1577](https://docs.rs#1577)    /// buf.push_back(1);
[1578](https://docs.rs#1578)    /// buf.push_back(2);
[1579](https://docs.rs#1579)    ///
[1580](https://docs.rs#1580)    /// assert_eq!(buf.swap_remove_back(0), Some(0));
[1581](https://docs.rs#1581)    /// assert_eq!(buf, [2, 1].into());
[1582](https://docs.rs#1582)    /// ```
[1583](https://docs.rs#1583)    pub fn swap_remove_back(&mut self, index: usize) -> Option<T> {
[1584](https://docs.rs#1584)        let length = self.len();
[1585](https://docs.rs#1585)        if length > 0 && index < length - 1 {
[1586](https://docs.rs#1586)            self.swap(index, length - 1);
[1587](https://docs.rs#1587)        } else if index >= length {
[1588](https://docs.rs#1588)            return None;
[1589](https://docs.rs#1589)        }
[1590](https://docs.rs#1590)        self.pop_back()
[1591](https://docs.rs#1591)    }
[1592](https://docs.rs#1592)
[1593](https://docs.rs#1593)    /// Removes an element from anywhere in the `ArrayDeque` and returns it,
[1594](https://docs.rs#1594)    /// replacing it with the first element.
[1595](https://docs.rs#1595)    ///
[1596](https://docs.rs#1596)    /// This does not preserve ordering, but is O(1).
[1597](https://docs.rs#1597)    ///
[1598](https://docs.rs#1598)    /// Returns `None` if `index` is out of bounds.
[1599](https://docs.rs#1599)    ///
[1600](https://docs.rs#1600)    /// Element at index 0 is the front of the queue.
[1601](https://docs.rs#1601)    ///
[1602](https://docs.rs#1602)    /// # Examples
[1603](https://docs.rs#1603)    ///
[1604](https://docs.rs#1604)    /// ```
[1605](https://docs.rs#1605)    /// use arraydeque::ArrayDeque;
[1606](https://docs.rs#1606)    ///
[1607](https://docs.rs#1607)    /// let mut buf: ArrayDeque<_, 3> = ArrayDeque::new();
[1608](https://docs.rs#1608)    /// assert_eq!(buf.swap_remove_back(0), None);
[1609](https://docs.rs#1609)    ///
[1610](https://docs.rs#1610)    /// buf.push_back(0);
[1611](https://docs.rs#1611)    /// buf.push_back(1);
[1612](https://docs.rs#1612)    /// buf.push_back(2);
[1613](https://docs.rs#1613)    ///
[1614](https://docs.rs#1614)    /// assert_eq!(buf.swap_remove_front(2), Some(2));
[1615](https://docs.rs#1615)    /// assert_eq!(buf, [1, 0].into());
[1616](https://docs.rs#1616)    /// ```
[1617](https://docs.rs#1617)    pub fn swap_remove_front(&mut self, index: usize) -> Option<T> {
[1618](https://docs.rs#1618)        let length = self.len();
[1619](https://docs.rs#1619)        if length > 0 && index < length && index != 0 {
[1620](https://docs.rs#1620)            self.swap(index, 0);
[1621](https://docs.rs#1621)        } else if index >= length {
[1622](https://docs.rs#1622)            return None;
[1623](https://docs.rs#1623)        }
[1624](https://docs.rs#1624)        self.pop_front()
[1625](https://docs.rs#1625)    }
[1626](https://docs.rs#1626)
[1627](https://docs.rs#1627)    /// Removes and returns the element at `index` from the `ArrayDeque`.
[1628](https://docs.rs#1628)    /// Whichever end is closer to the removal point will be moved to make
[1629](https://docs.rs#1629)    /// room, and all the affected elements will be moved to new positions.
[1630](https://docs.rs#1630)    /// Returns `None` if `index` is out of bounds.
[1631](https://docs.rs#1631)    ///
[1632](https://docs.rs#1632)    /// Element at index 0 is the front of the queue.
[1633](https://docs.rs#1633)    ///
[1634](https://docs.rs#1634)    /// # Examples
[1635](https://docs.rs#1635)    ///
[1636](https://docs.rs#1636)    /// ```
[1637](https://docs.rs#1637)    /// use arraydeque::ArrayDeque;
[1638](https://docs.rs#1638)    ///
[1639](https://docs.rs#1639)    /// let mut buf: ArrayDeque<_, 3> = ArrayDeque::new();
[1640](https://docs.rs#1640)    ///
[1641](https://docs.rs#1641)    /// buf.push_back(0);
[1642](https://docs.rs#1642)    /// buf.push_back(1);
[1643](https://docs.rs#1643)    /// buf.push_back(2);
[1644](https://docs.rs#1644)    ///
[1645](https://docs.rs#1645)    /// assert_eq!(buf.remove(1), Some(1));
[1646](https://docs.rs#1646)    /// assert_eq!(buf, [0, 2].into());
[1647](https://docs.rs#1647)    /// ```
[1648](https://docs.rs#1648)    pub fn remove(&mut self, index: usize) -> Option<T> {
[1649](https://docs.rs#1649)        if self.is_empty() || self.len() <= index {
[1650](https://docs.rs#1650)            return None;
[1651](https://docs.rs#1651)        }
[1652](https://docs.rs#1652)
[1653](https://docs.rs#1653)        // There are three main cases:
[1654](https://docs.rs#1654)        //  Elements are contiguous
[1655](https://docs.rs#1655)        //  Elements are discontiguous and the removal is in the tail section
[1656](https://docs.rs#1656)        //  Elements are discontiguous and the removal is in the head section
[1657](https://docs.rs#1657)        //      - special case when elements are technically contiguous,
[1658](https://docs.rs#1658)        //        but self.head = 0
[1659](https://docs.rs#1659)        //
[1660](https://docs.rs#1660)        // For each of those there are two more cases:
[1661](https://docs.rs#1661)        //  Insert is closer to tail
[1662](https://docs.rs#1662)        //  Insert is closer to head
[1663](https://docs.rs#1663)        //
[1664](https://docs.rs#1664)        // Key: H - self.head
[1665](https://docs.rs#1665)        //      T - self.tail
[1666](https://docs.rs#1666)        //      o - Valid element
[1667](https://docs.rs#1667)        //      x - Element marked for removal
[1668](https://docs.rs#1668)        //      R - Indicates element that is being removed
[1669](https://docs.rs#1669)        //      M - Indicates element was moved
[1670](https://docs.rs#1670)
[1671](https://docs.rs#1671)        let idx = Self::wrap_add(self.tail(), index);
[1672](https://docs.rs#1672)
[1673](https://docs.rs#1673)        let elem = unsafe { Some(self.buffer_read(idx)) };
[1674](https://docs.rs#1674)
[1675](https://docs.rs#1675)        let distance_to_tail = index;
[1676](https://docs.rs#1676)        let distance_to_head = self.len() - index;
[1677](https://docs.rs#1677)
[1678](https://docs.rs#1678)        let contiguous = self.is_contiguous();
[1679](https://docs.rs#1679)
[1680](https://docs.rs#1680)        match (
[1681](https://docs.rs#1681)            contiguous,
[1682](https://docs.rs#1682)            distance_to_tail <= distance_to_head,
[1683](https://docs.rs#1683)            idx >= self.tail(),
[1684](https://docs.rs#1684)        ) {
[1685](https://docs.rs#1685)            (true, true, _) => {
[1686](https://docs.rs#1686)                unsafe {
[1687](https://docs.rs#1687)                    // contiguous, remove closer to tail:
[1688](https://docs.rs#1688)                    //
[1689](https://docs.rs#1689)                    //             T   R         H
[1690](https://docs.rs#1690)                    //      [. . . o o x o o o o . . . . . .]
[1691](https://docs.rs#1691)                    //
[1692](https://docs.rs#1692)                    //               T           H
[1693](https://docs.rs#1693)                    //      [. . . . o o o o o o . . . . . .]
[1694](https://docs.rs#1694)                    //               M M
[1695](https://docs.rs#1695)
[1696](https://docs.rs#1696)                    let tail = self.tail();
[1697](https://docs.rs#1697)                    self.copy(tail + 1, tail, index);
[1698](https://docs.rs#1698)                    self.set_tail_forward();
[1699](https://docs.rs#1699)                }
[1700](https://docs.rs#1700)            }
[1701](https://docs.rs#1701)            (true, false, _) => {
[1702](https://docs.rs#1702)                unsafe {
[1703](https://docs.rs#1703)                    // contiguous, remove closer to head:
[1704](https://docs.rs#1704)                    //
[1705](https://docs.rs#1705)                    //             T       R     H
[1706](https://docs.rs#1706)                    //      [. . . o o o o x o o . . . . . .]
[1707](https://docs.rs#1707)                    //
[1708](https://docs.rs#1708)                    //             T           H
[1709](https://docs.rs#1709)                    //      [. . . o o o o o o . . . . . . .]
[1710](https://docs.rs#1710)                    //                     M M
[1711](https://docs.rs#1711)
[1712](https://docs.rs#1712)                    let head = self.head();
[1713](https://docs.rs#1713)                    self.copy(idx, idx + 1, head - idx - 1);
[1714](https://docs.rs#1714)                    self.set_head_backward();
[1715](https://docs.rs#1715)                }
[1716](https://docs.rs#1716)            }
[1717](https://docs.rs#1717)            (false, true, true) => {
[1718](https://docs.rs#1718)                unsafe {
[1719](https://docs.rs#1719)                    // discontiguous, remove closer to tail, tail section:
[1720](https://docs.rs#1720)                    //
[1721](https://docs.rs#1721)                    //                   H         T   R
[1722](https://docs.rs#1722)                    //      [o o o o o o . . . . . o o x o o]
[1723](https://docs.rs#1723)                    //
[1724](https://docs.rs#1724)                    //                   H           T
[1725](https://docs.rs#1725)                    //      [o o o o o o . . . . . . o o o o]
[1726](https://docs.rs#1726)                    //                               M M
[1727](https://docs.rs#1727)
[1728](https://docs.rs#1728)                    let tail = self.tail();
[1729](https://docs.rs#1729)                    self.copy(tail + 1, tail, index);
[1730](https://docs.rs#1730)                    self.set_tail_forward();
[1731](https://docs.rs#1731)                }
[1732](https://docs.rs#1732)            }
[1733](https://docs.rs#1733)            (false, false, false) => {
[1734](https://docs.rs#1734)                unsafe {
[1735](https://docs.rs#1735)                    // discontiguous, remove closer to head, head section:
[1736](https://docs.rs#1736)                    //
[1737](https://docs.rs#1737)                    //               R     H           T
[1738](https://docs.rs#1738)                    //      [o o o o x o o . . . . . . o o o]
[1739](https://docs.rs#1739)                    //
[1740](https://docs.rs#1740)                    //                   H             T
[1741](https://docs.rs#1741)                    //      [o o o o o o . . . . . . . o o o]
[1742](https://docs.rs#1742)                    //               M M
[1743](https://docs.rs#1743)
[1744](https://docs.rs#1744)                    let head = self.head();
[1745](https://docs.rs#1745)                    self.copy(idx, idx + 1, head - idx - 1);
[1746](https://docs.rs#1746)                    self.set_head_backward();
[1747](https://docs.rs#1747)                }
[1748](https://docs.rs#1748)            }
[1749](https://docs.rs#1749)            (false, false, true) => {
[1750](https://docs.rs#1750)                unsafe {
[1751](https://docs.rs#1751)                    // discontiguous, remove closer to head, tail section:
[1752](https://docs.rs#1752)                    //
[1753](https://docs.rs#1753)                    //             H           T         R
[1754](https://docs.rs#1754)                    //      [o o o . . . . . . o o o o o x o]
[1755](https://docs.rs#1755)                    //
[1756](https://docs.rs#1756)                    //           H             T
[1757](https://docs.rs#1757)                    //      [o o . . . . . . . o o o o o o o]
[1758](https://docs.rs#1758)                    //       M M                         M M
[1759](https://docs.rs#1759)                    //
[1760](https://docs.rs#1760)                    // or quasi-discontiguous, remove next to head, tail section:
[1761](https://docs.rs#1761)                    //
[1762](https://docs.rs#1762)                    //       H                 T         R
[1763](https://docs.rs#1763)                    //      [. . . . . . . . . o o o o o x o]
[1764](https://docs.rs#1764)                    //
[1765](https://docs.rs#1765)                    //                         T           H
[1766](https://docs.rs#1766)                    //      [. . . . . . . . . o o o o o o .]
[1767](https://docs.rs#1767)                    //                                   M
[1768](https://docs.rs#1768)
[1769](https://docs.rs#1769)                    // draw in elements in the tail section
[1770](https://docs.rs#1770)                    self.copy(idx, idx + 1, CAP - idx - 1);
[1771](https://docs.rs#1771)
[1772](https://docs.rs#1772)                    // Prevents underflow.
[1773](https://docs.rs#1773)                    if self.head() != 0 {
[1774](https://docs.rs#1774)                        // copy first element into empty spot
[1775](https://docs.rs#1775)                        self.copy(CAP - 1, 0, 1);
[1776](https://docs.rs#1776)
[1777](https://docs.rs#1777)                        // move elements in the head section backwards
[1778](https://docs.rs#1778)                        let head = self.head();
[1779](https://docs.rs#1779)                        self.copy(0, 1, head - 1);
[1780](https://docs.rs#1780)                    }
[1781](https://docs.rs#1781)
[1782](https://docs.rs#1782)                    self.set_head_backward();
[1783](https://docs.rs#1783)                }
[1784](https://docs.rs#1784)            }
[1785](https://docs.rs#1785)            (false, true, false) => {
[1786](https://docs.rs#1786)                unsafe {
[1787](https://docs.rs#1787)                    // discontiguous, remove closer to tail, head section:
[1788](https://docs.rs#1788)                    //
[1789](https://docs.rs#1789)                    //           R               H     T
[1790](https://docs.rs#1790)                    //      [o o x o o o o o o o . . . o o o]
[1791](https://docs.rs#1791)                    //
[1792](https://docs.rs#1792)                    //                           H       T
[1793](https://docs.rs#1793)                    //      [o o o o o o o o o o . . . . o o]
[1794](https://docs.rs#1794)                    //       M M M                       M M
[1795](https://docs.rs#1795)
[1796](https://docs.rs#1796)                    let tail = self.tail();
[1797](https://docs.rs#1797)                    // draw in elements up to idx
[1798](https://docs.rs#1798)                    self.copy(1, 0, idx);
[1799](https://docs.rs#1799)
[1800](https://docs.rs#1800)                    // copy last element into empty spot
[1801](https://docs.rs#1801)                    self.copy(0, CAP - 1, 1);
[1802](https://docs.rs#1802)
[1803](https://docs.rs#1803)                    // move elements from tail to end forward, excluding the last one
[1804](https://docs.rs#1804)                    self.copy(tail + 1, tail, CAP - tail - 1);
[1805](https://docs.rs#1805)
[1806](https://docs.rs#1806)                    self.set_tail_forward();
[1807](https://docs.rs#1807)                }
[1808](https://docs.rs#1808)            }
[1809](https://docs.rs#1809)        }
[1810](https://docs.rs#1810)
[1811](https://docs.rs#1811)        elem
[1812](https://docs.rs#1812)    }
[1813](https://docs.rs#1813)
[1814](https://docs.rs#1814)    /// Splits the collection into two at the given index.
[1815](https://docs.rs#1815)    ///
[1816](https://docs.rs#1816)    /// Returns a newly allocated `Self`. `self` contains elements `[0, at)`,
[1817](https://docs.rs#1817)    /// and the returned `Self` contains elements `[at, len)`.
[1818](https://docs.rs#1818)    ///
[1819](https://docs.rs#1819)    /// Element at index 0 is the front of the queue.
[1820](https://docs.rs#1820)    ///
[1821](https://docs.rs#1821)    /// # Panics
[1822](https://docs.rs#1822)    ///
[1823](https://docs.rs#1823)    /// Panics if `at > len`
[1824](https://docs.rs#1824)    ///
[1825](https://docs.rs#1825)    /// # Examples
[1826](https://docs.rs#1826)    ///
[1827](https://docs.rs#1827)    /// ```
[1828](https://docs.rs#1828)    /// use arraydeque::ArrayDeque;
[1829](https://docs.rs#1829)    ///
[1830](https://docs.rs#1830)    /// let mut buf: ArrayDeque<_, 3> = ArrayDeque::new();
[1831](https://docs.rs#1831)    ///
[1832](https://docs.rs#1832)    /// buf.push_back(0);
[1833](https://docs.rs#1833)    /// buf.push_back(1);
[1834](https://docs.rs#1834)    /// buf.push_back(2);
[1835](https://docs.rs#1835)    ///
[1836](https://docs.rs#1836)    /// // buf = [0], buf2 = [1, 2]
[1837](https://docs.rs#1837)    /// let buf2 = buf.split_off(1);
[1838](https://docs.rs#1838)    ///
[1839](https://docs.rs#1839)    /// assert_eq!(buf.len(), 1);
[1840](https://docs.rs#1840)    /// assert_eq!(buf2.len(), 2);
[1841](https://docs.rs#1841)    /// ```
[1842](https://docs.rs#1842)    #[track_caller]
[1843](https://docs.rs#1843)    #[inline]
[1844](https://docs.rs#1844)    pub fn split_off(&mut self, at: usize) -> Self {
[1845](https://docs.rs#1845)        let len = self.len();
[1846](https://docs.rs#1846)        assert!(at <= len, "`at` out of bounds");
[1847](https://docs.rs#1847)
[1848](https://docs.rs#1848)        let other_len = len - at;
[1849](https://docs.rs#1849)        let mut other = Self::new();
[1850](https://docs.rs#1850)
[1851](https://docs.rs#1851)        unsafe {
[1852](https://docs.rs#1852)            let (first_half, second_half) = self.as_slices();
[1853](https://docs.rs#1853)
[1854](https://docs.rs#1854)            let first_len = first_half.len();
[1855](https://docs.rs#1855)            let second_len = second_half.len();
[1856](https://docs.rs#1856)            if at < first_len {
[1857](https://docs.rs#1857)                // `at` lies in the first half.
[1858](https://docs.rs#1858)                let amount_in_first = first_len - at;
[1859](https://docs.rs#1859)
[1860](https://docs.rs#1860)                ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(
[1861](https://docs.rs#1861)                    first_half.as_ptr().add(at),
[1862](https://docs.rs#1862)                    other.ptr_mut(),
[1863](https://docs.rs#1863)                    amount_in_first,
[1864](https://docs.rs#1864)                );
[1865](https://docs.rs#1865)
[1866](https://docs.rs#1866)                // just take all of the second half.
[1867](https://docs.rs#1867)                ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(
[1868](https://docs.rs#1868)                    second_half.as_ptr(),
[1869](https://docs.rs#1869)                    other.ptr_mut().add(amount_in_first),
[1870](https://docs.rs#1870)                    second_len,
[1871](https://docs.rs#1871)                );
[1872](https://docs.rs#1872)            } else {
[1873](https://docs.rs#1873)                // `at` lies in the second half, need to factor in the elements we skipped
[1874](https://docs.rs#1874)                // in the first half.
[1875](https://docs.rs#1875)                let offset = at - first_len;
[1876](https://docs.rs#1876)                let amount_in_second = second_len - offset;
[1877](https://docs.rs#1877)                ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(
[1878](https://docs.rs#1878)                    second_half.as_ptr().add(offset),
[1879](https://docs.rs#1879)                    other.ptr_mut(),
[1880](https://docs.rs#1880)                    amount_in_second,
[1881](https://docs.rs#1881)                );
[1882](https://docs.rs#1882)            }
[1883](https://docs.rs#1883)        }
[1884](https://docs.rs#1884)
[1885](https://docs.rs#1885)        // Cleanup where the ends of the buffers are
[1886](https://docs.rs#1886)        unsafe {
[1887](https://docs.rs#1887)            self.set_len(at);
[1888](https://docs.rs#1888)            other.set_len(other_len);
[1889](https://docs.rs#1889)        }
[1890](https://docs.rs#1890)
[1891](https://docs.rs#1891)        other
[1892](https://docs.rs#1892)    }
[1893](https://docs.rs#1893)
[1894](https://docs.rs#1894)    /// Retains only the elements specified by the predicate.
[1895](https://docs.rs#1895)    ///
[1896](https://docs.rs#1896)    /// In other words, remove all elements `e` such that `f(&e)` returns false.
[1897](https://docs.rs#1897)    /// This method operates in place and preserves the order of the retained
[1898](https://docs.rs#1898)    /// elements.
[1899](https://docs.rs#1899)    ///
[1900](https://docs.rs#1900)    /// # Examples
[1901](https://docs.rs#1901)    ///
[1902](https://docs.rs#1902)    /// ```
[1903](https://docs.rs#1903)    /// use arraydeque::ArrayDeque;
[1904](https://docs.rs#1904)    ///
[1905](https://docs.rs#1905)    /// let mut buf: ArrayDeque<_, 4> = ArrayDeque::new();
[1906](https://docs.rs#1906)    ///
[1907](https://docs.rs#1907)    /// buf.extend_back(0..4);
[1908](https://docs.rs#1908)    /// buf.retain(|&x| x % 2 == 0);
[1909](https://docs.rs#1909)    ///
[1910](https://docs.rs#1910)    /// assert_eq!(buf, [0, 2].into());
[1911](https://docs.rs#1911)    /// ```
[1912](https://docs.rs#1912)    pub fn retain<F>(&mut self, mut f: F)
[1913](https://docs.rs#1913)    where
[1914](https://docs.rs#1914)        F: FnMut(&T) -> bool,
[1915](https://docs.rs#1915)    {
[1916](https://docs.rs#1916)        let len = self.len();
[1917](https://docs.rs#1917)        let mut del = 0;
[1918](https://docs.rs#1918)        for i in 0..len {
[1919](https://docs.rs#1919)            if !f(&self[i]) {
[1920](https://docs.rs#1920)                del += 1;
[1921](https://docs.rs#1921)            } else if del > 0 {
[1922](https://docs.rs#1922)                self.swap(i - del, i);
[1923](https://docs.rs#1923)            }
[1924](https://docs.rs#1924)        }
[1925](https://docs.rs#1925)        if del > 0 {
[1926](https://docs.rs#1926)            for _ in (len - del)..self.len() {
[1927](https://docs.rs#1927)                self.pop_back();
[1928](https://docs.rs#1928)            }
[1929](https://docs.rs#1929)        }
[1930](https://docs.rs#1930)    }
[1931](https://docs.rs#1931)
[1932](https://docs.rs#1932)    /// Returns a pair of slices which contain, in order, the contents of the
[1933](https://docs.rs#1933)    /// `ArrayDeque`.
[1934](https://docs.rs#1934)    ///
[1935](https://docs.rs#1935)    /// # Examples
[1936](https://docs.rs#1936)    ///
[1937](https://docs.rs#1937)    /// ```
[1938](https://docs.rs#1938)    /// use arraydeque::ArrayDeque;
[1939](https://docs.rs#1939)    ///
[1940](https://docs.rs#1940)    /// let mut buf: ArrayDeque<_, 7> = ArrayDeque::new();
[1941](https://docs.rs#1941)    ///
[1942](https://docs.rs#1942)    /// buf.push_back(0);
[1943](https://docs.rs#1943)    /// buf.push_back(1);
[1944](https://docs.rs#1944)    ///
[1945](https://docs.rs#1945)    /// assert_eq!(buf.as_slices(), (&[0, 1][..], &[][..]));
[1946](https://docs.rs#1946)    ///
[1947](https://docs.rs#1947)    /// buf.push_front(2);
[1948](https://docs.rs#1948)    ///
[1949](https://docs.rs#1949)    /// assert_eq!(buf.as_slices(), (&[2][..], &[0, 1][..]));
[1950](https://docs.rs#1950)    /// ```
[1951](https://docs.rs#1951)    #[inline]
[1952](https://docs.rs#1952)    pub fn as_slices(&self) -> (&[T], &[T]) {
[1953](https://docs.rs#1953)        let contiguous = self.is_contiguous();
[1954](https://docs.rs#1954)        let head = self.head();
[1955](https://docs.rs#1955)        let tail = self.tail();
[1956](https://docs.rs#1956)        let buf = self.as_uninit_slice();
[1957](https://docs.rs#1957)
[1958](https://docs.rs#1958)        if contiguous {
[1959](https://docs.rs#1959)            let (empty, buf) = buf.split_at(0);
[1960](https://docs.rs#1960)            unsafe {
[1961](https://docs.rs#1961)                (
[1962](https://docs.rs#1962)                    slice_assume_init_ref(&buf[tail..head]),
[1963](https://docs.rs#1963)                    slice_assume_init_ref(empty),
[1964](https://docs.rs#1964)                )
[1965](https://docs.rs#1965)            }
[1966](https://docs.rs#1966)        } else {
[1967](https://docs.rs#1967)            let (mid, right) = buf.split_at(tail);
[1968](https://docs.rs#1968)            let (left, _) = mid.split_at(head);
[1969](https://docs.rs#1969)
[1970](https://docs.rs#1970)            unsafe { (slice_assume_init_ref(right), slice_assume_init_ref(left)) }
[1971](https://docs.rs#1971)        }
[1972](https://docs.rs#1972)    }

[2087](https://docs.rs#2087)impl<T, const CAP: usize, B: Behavior> PartialEq for ArrayDeque<T, CAP, B>
[2088](https://docs.rs#2088)where
[2089](https://docs.rs#2089)    T: PartialEq,
[2090](https://docs.rs#2090){
[2091](https://docs.rs#2091)    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
[2092](https://docs.rs#2092)        if self.len() != other.len() {
[2093](https://docs.rs#2093)            return false;
[2094](https://docs.rs#2094)        }
[2095](https://docs.rs#2095)        let (sa, sb) = self.as_slices();
[2096](https://docs.rs#2096)        let (oa, ob) = other.as_slices();
[2097](https://docs.rs#2097)        match sa.len().cmp(&oa.len()) {
[2098](https://docs.rs#2098)            Ordering::Equal => sa == oa && sb == ob,
[2099](https://docs.rs#2099)            Ordering::Less => {
[2100](https://docs.rs#2100)                // Always divisible in three sections, for example:
[2101](https://docs.rs#2101)                // self:  [a b c|d e f]
[2102](https://docs.rs#2102)                // other: [0 1 2 3|4 5]
[2103](https://docs.rs#2103)                // front = 3, mid = 1,
[2104](https://docs.rs#2104)                // [a b c] == [0 1 2] && [d] == [3] && [e f] == [4 5]
[2105](https://docs.rs#2105)                let front = sa.len();
[2106](https://docs.rs#2106)                let mid = oa.len() - front;
[2107](https://docs.rs#2107)
[2108](https://docs.rs#2108)                let (oa_front, oa_mid) = oa.split_at(front);
[2109](https://docs.rs#2109)                let (sb_mid, sb_back) = sb.split_at(mid);
[2110](https://docs.rs#2110)                debug_assert_eq!(sa.len(), oa_front.len());
[2111](https://docs.rs#2111)                debug_assert_eq!(sb_mid.len(), oa_mid.len());
[2112](https://docs.rs#2112)                debug_assert_eq!(sb_back.len(), ob.len());
[2113](https://docs.rs#2113)                sa == oa_front && sb_mid == oa_mid && sb_back == ob
[2114](https://docs.rs#2114)            }
[2115](https://docs.rs#2115)            Ordering::Greater => {
[2116](https://docs.rs#2116)                let front = oa.len();
[2117](https://docs.rs#2117)                let mid = sa.len() - front;
[2118](https://docs.rs#2118)
[2119](https://docs.rs#2119)                let (sa_front, sa_mid) = sa.split_at(front);
[2120](https://docs.rs#2120)                let (ob_mid, ob_back) = ob.split_at(mid);
[2121](https://docs.rs#2121)                debug_assert_eq!(sa_front.len(), oa.len());
[2122](https://docs.rs#2122)                debug_assert_eq!(sa_mid.len(), ob_mid.len());
[2123](https://docs.rs#2123)                debug_assert_eq!(sb.len(), ob_back.len());
[2124](https://docs.rs#2124)                sa_front == oa && sa_mid == ob_mid && sb == ob_back
[2125](https://docs.rs#2125)            }
[2126](https://docs.rs#2126)        }
[2127](https://docs.rs#2127)    }

[2373](https://docs.rs#2373)/// Draining `ArrayDeque` iterator
[2374](https://docs.rs#2374)pub struct Drain<'a, T, const CAP: usize, B>
[2375](https://docs.rs#2375)where
[2376](https://docs.rs#2376)    B: Behavior,
[2377](https://docs.rs#2377){
[2378](https://docs.rs#2378)    after_tail: usize,
[2379](https://docs.rs#2379)    after_len: usize,
[2380](https://docs.rs#2380)    iter: Iter<'a, T>,
[2381](https://docs.rs#2381)    deque: *mut ArrayDeque<T, CAP, B>,
[2382](https://docs.rs#2382)}
[2383](https://docs.rs#2383)
[2384](https://docs.rs#2384)impl<'a, T, const CAP: usize, B> Drop for Drain<'a, T, CAP, B>
[2385](https://docs.rs#2385)where
[2386](https://docs.rs#2386)    B: Behavior,
[2387](https://docs.rs#2387){
[2388](https://docs.rs#2388)    fn drop(&mut self) {
[2389](https://docs.rs#2389)        for _ in self.by_ref() {}
[2390](https://docs.rs#2390)
[2391](https://docs.rs#2391)        let source_deque = unsafe { &mut *self.deque };
[2392](https://docs.rs#2392)
[2393](https://docs.rs#2393)        let tail_len = source_deque.len();
[2394](https://docs.rs#2394)        let head_len = self.after_len;
[2395](https://docs.rs#2395)
[2396](https://docs.rs#2396)        let orig_tail = source_deque.tail();
[2397](https://docs.rs#2397)        let drain_tail = wrap_add(orig_tail, tail_len, CAP);
[2398](https://docs.rs#2398)        let drain_head = self.after_tail;
[2399](https://docs.rs#2399)        let orig_head = wrap_add(drain_head, head_len, CAP);
[2400](https://docs.rs#2400)        let orig_len = wrap_sub(orig_head, orig_tail, CAP);
[2401](https://docs.rs#2401)
[2402](https://docs.rs#2402)        // Restore the original len value
[2403](https://docs.rs#2403)        unsafe { source_deque.set_len(orig_len) }
[2404](https://docs.rs#2404)        match (tail_len, head_len) {
[2405](https://docs.rs#2405)            (0, 0) => unsafe {
[2406](https://docs.rs#2406)                source_deque.set_tail(0);
[2407](https://docs.rs#2407)                source_deque.set_len(0);
[2408](https://docs.rs#2408)            },
[2409](https://docs.rs#2409)            (0, _) => unsafe {
[2410](https://docs.rs#2410)                source_deque.set_tail(drain_head);
[2411](https://docs.rs#2411)                source_deque.set_len(head_len);
[2412](https://docs.rs#2412)            },
[2413](https://docs.rs#2413)            (_, 0) => unsafe { source_deque.set_len(tail_len) },
[2414](https://docs.rs#2414)            _ => unsafe {
[2415](https://docs.rs#2415)                if tail_len <= head_len {
[2416](https://docs.rs#2416)                    let new_tail = wrap_sub(drain_head, tail_len, CAP);
[2417](https://docs.rs#2417)                    source_deque.set_tail(new_tail);
[2418](https://docs.rs#2418)                    source_deque.set_len(tail_len + head_len);
[2419](https://docs.rs#2419)                    source_deque.wrap_copy(new_tail, orig_tail, tail_len);
[2420](https://docs.rs#2420)                } else {
[2421](https://docs.rs#2421)                    source_deque.set_len(tail_len + head_len);
[2422](https://docs.rs#2422)                    source_deque.wrap_copy(drain_tail, drain_head, head_len);
[2423](https://docs.rs#2423)                }
[2424](https://docs.rs#2424)            },
[2425](https://docs.rs#2425)        }
[2426](https://docs.rs#2426)    }
[2427](https://docs.rs#2427)}
[2428](https://docs.rs#2428)

[2698](https://docs.rs#2698)        use std::cell::Cell;
[2699](https://docs.rs#2699)
[2700](https://docs.rs#2700)        let flag = &Cell::new(0);
[2701](https://docs.rs#2701)
[2702](https://docs.rs#2702)        struct Bump<'a>(&'a Cell<i32>);
[2703](https://docs.rs#2703)
[2704](https://docs.rs#2704)        impl<'a> Drop for Bump<'a> {
[2705](https://docs.rs#2705)            fn drop(&mut self) {
[2706](https://docs.rs#2706)                let n = self.0.get();
[2707](https://docs.rs#2707)                self.0.set(n + 1);
[2708](https://docs.rs#2708)            }
[2709](https://docs.rs#2709)        }
[2710](https://docs.rs#2710)
[2711](https://docs.rs#2711)        {

[2713](https://docs.rs#2713)            tester.push_back(Bump(flag));
[2714](https://docs.rs#2714)            tester.push_back(Bump(flag));
[2715](https://docs.rs#2715)        }
[2716](https://docs.rs#2716)        assert_eq!(flag.get(), 2);
[2717](https://docs.rs#2717)
[2718](https://docs.rs#2718)        // test something with the nullable pointer optimization
[2719](https://docs.rs#2719)        flag.set(0);
[2720](https://docs.rs#2720)        {
[2721](https://docs.rs#2721)            let mut tester = ArrayDeque::<_, 3>::new();
[2722](https://docs.rs#2722)            tester.push_back(vec![Bump(flag)]);
[2723](https://docs.rs#2723)            tester.push_back(vec![Bump(flag), Bump(flag)]);
[2724](https://docs.rs#2724)            tester.push_back(vec![]);
[2725](https://docs.rs#2725)            tester.push_back(vec![Bump(flag)]);
[2726](https://docs.rs#2726)            assert_eq!(flag.get(), 1);
[2727](https://docs.rs#2727)            drop(tester.pop_back());
[2728](https://docs.rs#2728)            assert_eq!(flag.get(), 1);
[2729](https://docs.rs#2729)            drop(tester.pop_back());
[2730](https://docs.rs#2730)            assert_eq!(flag.get(), 3);
[2731](https://docs.rs#2731)        }

[2733](https://docs.rs#2733)    }

[2800](https://docs.rs#2800)    fn test_swap_front_back_remove() {
[2801](https://docs.rs#2801)        fn test(back: bool) {
[2802](https://docs.rs#2802)            const CAP: usize = 16;
[2803](https://docs.rs#2803)            let mut tester = ArrayDeque::<_, CAP>::new();
[2804](https://docs.rs#2804)            let usable_cap = tester.capacity();
[2805](https://docs.rs#2805)            let final_len = usable_cap / 2;
[2806](https://docs.rs#2806)
[2807](https://docs.rs#2807)            for len in 0..final_len {
[2808](https://docs.rs#2808)                let expected = if back {
[2809](https://docs.rs#2809)                    (0..len).collect()
[2810](https://docs.rs#2810)                } else {
[2811](https://docs.rs#2811)                    (0..len).rev().collect()
[2812](https://docs.rs#2812)                };
[2813](https://docs.rs#2813)                for padding in 0..usable_cap {
[2814](https://docs.rs#2814)                    unsafe {
[2815](https://docs.rs#2815)                        tester.set_tail(padding);
[2816](https://docs.rs#2816)                        tester.set_len(0);
[2817](https://docs.rs#2817)                    }
[2818](https://docs.rs#2818)                    if back {
[2819](https://docs.rs#2819)                        for i in 0..len * 2 {
[2820](https://docs.rs#2820)                            tester.push_front(i);
[2821](https://docs.rs#2821)                        }
[2822](https://docs.rs#2822)                        for i in 0..len {
[2823](https://docs.rs#2823)                            assert_eq!(tester.swap_remove_back(i), Some(len * 2 - 1 - i));
[2824](https://docs.rs#2824)                        }
[2825](https://docs.rs#2825)                    } else {
[2826](https://docs.rs#2826)                        for i in 0..len * 2 {
[2827](https://docs.rs#2827)                            tester.push_back(i);
[2828](https://docs.rs#2828)                        }
[2829](https://docs.rs#2829)                        for i in 0..len {
[2830](https://docs.rs#2830)                            let idx = tester.len() - 1 - i;
[2831](https://docs.rs#2831)                            assert_eq!(tester.swap_remove_front(idx), Some(len * 2 - 1 - i));
[2832](https://docs.rs#2832)                        }
[2833](https://docs.rs#2833)                    }
[2834](https://docs.rs#2834)                    assert!(tester.tail() < CAP);
[2835](https://docs.rs#2835)                    assert!(tester.head() < CAP);
[2836](https://docs.rs#2836)                    assert_eq!(tester, expected);
[2837](https://docs.rs#2837)                }
[2838](https://docs.rs#2838)            }
[2839](https://docs.rs#2839)        }

[2860](https://docs.rs#2860)    fn test_split_off() {
[2861](https://docs.rs#2861)        const CAP: usize = 16;
[2862](https://docs.rs#2862)        let mut tester = ArrayDeque::<_, CAP>::new();
[2863](https://docs.rs#2863)        for len in 0..CAP + 1 {
[2864](https://docs.rs#2864)            // index to split at
[2865](https://docs.rs#2865)            for at in 0..len + 1 {
[2866](https://docs.rs#2866)                for padding in 0..CAP {
[2867](https://docs.rs#2867)                    let expected_self = (0..).take(at).collect();
[2868](https://docs.rs#2868)                    let expected_other = (at..).take(len - at).collect();
[2869](https://docs.rs#2869)                    unsafe {
[2870](https://docs.rs#2870)                        tester.set_len(0);
[2871](https://docs.rs#2871)                        tester.set_tail(padding);
[2872](https://docs.rs#2872)                    }
[2873](https://docs.rs#2873)                    for i in 0..len {
[2874](https://docs.rs#2874)                        tester.push_back(i);
[2875](https://docs.rs#2875)                    }
[2876](https://docs.rs#2876)                    let result = tester.split_off(at);
[2877](https://docs.rs#2877)                    assert!(tester.tail() < CAP);
[2878](https://docs.rs#2878)                    assert!(tester.head() < CAP);
[2879](https://docs.rs#2879)                    assert!(result.tail() < CAP);
[2880](https://docs.rs#2880)                    assert!(result.head() < CAP);
[2881](https://docs.rs#2881)                    assert_eq!(tester, expected_self);
[2882](https://docs.rs#2882)                    assert_eq!(result, expected_other);
[2883](https://docs.rs#2883)                }

[2889](https://docs.rs#2889)    fn test_remove() {
[2890](https://docs.rs#2890)        const CAP: usize = 16;
[2891](https://docs.rs#2891)        let mut tester = ArrayDeque::<_, CAP>::new();
[2892](https://docs.rs#2892)
[2893](https://docs.rs#2893)        // len is the length *after* removal
[2894](https://docs.rs#2894)        for len in 0..CAP {
[2895](https://docs.rs#2895)            // 0, 1, 2, .., len - 1
[2896](https://docs.rs#2896)            let expected = (0..).take(len).collect();
[2897](https://docs.rs#2897)            for padding in 0..CAP {
[2898](https://docs.rs#2898)                for to_remove in 0..len + 1 {
[2899](https://docs.rs#2899)                    unsafe {
[2900](https://docs.rs#2900)                        tester.set_tail(padding);
[2901](https://docs.rs#2901)                        tester.set_len(0);
[2902](https://docs.rs#2902)                    }
[2903](https://docs.rs#2903)                    for i in 0..len {
[2904](https://docs.rs#2904)                        if i == to_remove {
[2905](https://docs.rs#2905)                            tester.push_back(1234);
[2906](https://docs.rs#2906)                        }
[2907](https://docs.rs#2907)                        tester.push_back(i);
[2908](https://docs.rs#2908)                    }
[2909](https://docs.rs#2909)                    if to_remove == len {
[2910](https://docs.rs#2910)                        tester.push_back(1234);
[2911](https://docs.rs#2911)                    }
[2912](https://docs.rs#2912)                    tester.remove(to_remove);
[2913](https://docs.rs#2913)                    assert!(tester.tail() < CAP);
[2914](https://docs.rs#2914)                    assert!(tester.head() < CAP);
[2915](https://docs.rs#2915)                    assert_eq!(tester, expected);
[2916](https://docs.rs#2916)                }
[2917](https://docs.rs#2917)            }
[2918](https://docs.rs#2918)        }

# arraydeque - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/arraydeque/latest/arraydeque/

## Expand description

A circular buffer with fixed capacity. Requires Rust 1.59+

It can be stored directly on the stack if needed.

This queue has `O(1)` amortized inserts and removals from both ends of the
container. It also has `O(1)` indexing like a vector. The contained elements
are not required to be copyable

This crate is inspired by **bluss/arrayvec**

[§](https://docs.rs#feature-flags)Feature Flags

The **arraydeque** crate has the following cargo feature flags:

- `std`- Optional, enabled by default
- Conversions between `ArrayDeque`and`Vec`
- Use libstd

[§](https://docs.rs#usage)Usage

First, add the following to your `Cargo.toml`:

```
[dependencies]
arraydeque = "0.5"
```
Next, add this to your crate root:

`extern crate arraydeque;`Currently arraydeque by default links to the standard library, but if you would
instead like to use arraydeque in a `#![no_std]` situation or crate you can
request this via:

```
[dependencies]
arraydeque = { version = "0.4", default-features = false }
```
[§](https://docs.rs#behaviors)Behaviors

`ArrayDeque` provides two different behaviors, `Saturating` and `Wrapping`,
determining whether to remove existing element automatically when pushing
to a full deque.

See the [behavior module documentation](https://docs.rs/behavior/index.html) for more.

## Re-exports[§](https://docs.rs#reexports)

- `pub use behavior::`- [Saturating](https://docs.rs/behavior/struct.Saturating.html);
- `pub use behavior::`- [Wrapping](https://docs.rs/behavior/struct.Wrapping.html);

## Modules[§](https://docs.rs#modules)

- [behavior](https://docs.rs/behavior/index.html)
- Behavior semantics for `ArrayDeque`.

## Structs[§](https://docs.rs#structs)

- [Array](https://docs.rs/struct.ArrayDeque.html)- Deque
- A fixed capacity ring buffer.
- [Capacity](https://docs.rs/struct.CapacityError.html)- Error
- Error value indicating insufficient capacity
- [Drain](https://docs.rs/struct.Drain.html)
- Draining `ArrayDeque`iterator
- [Into](https://docs.rs/struct.IntoIter.html)- Iter
- By-value `ArrayDeque`iterator
- [Iter](https://docs.rs/struct.Iter.html)
- `ArrayDeque`iterator
- [IterMut](https://docs.rs/struct.IterMut.html)
- `ArrayDeque`mutable iterator

## Traits[§](https://docs.rs#traits)

- [Range](https://docs.rs/trait.RangeArgument.html)- Argument
- **RangeArgument**is implemented by Rust’s built-in range types, produced by range syntax like- `..`,- `a..`,- `..b`or- `c..d`.
